post.summary: Release a template version to Test and Live in one call (Idempotency-Key required; dryRun previews)
post.description: Release a saved version to Test and Live in one call. Test runs first, then Live; each mode creates or reuses its candidate, reuses or writes an approval (a `test` approval in Test, a `sole` approval in Live only for the sole reviewer) and publishes at the expected generation. Test follows Live: a newer Test head stays and is reported as `kept`. Another reviewer's approval is needed otherwise: 409 `TEMPLATE_REVIEW_REQUIRED` with the plan; Test stays released and a repeat call resumes. `?dryRun=true` returns the plan and changes nothing. Send `Idempotency-Key`: the same key and body replays the stored answer with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. `expected` is the generation each head must still be at, `0` before a first release. A Test key may name only `test`; a Live key cannot release.

post.description: Saves, sends or schedules a message or a change run. A change sets inputs on many passes: one target (`templateIds` with filters, `passIds` up to 5,000, or the `importId` of an ended import), `patch` operations (`set`, `clear`, `shift`, `add`, or `$void` or `$design` alone) and an optional `message` for the lock screen (needs `notify`). `target.expectCount` is the count a preview showed: when the server's count differs by more than 2% the run does not start and the answer is 409 `SELECTION_CHANGED`. More than 20,000 passes is 422 `MATCH_TOO_BROAD`. A target key it does not define is 422 `BROADCAST_UNSUPPORTED_FILTER`, never ignored. Needs `messages:write` and, for a change, `passes:write`. Send an `Idempotency-Key`; the same key and body returns the same run.

post.summary: Count the passes a target matches
post.description: Counts the passes a target matches. With `patch` (and `notify`) it also previews a change: up to 20 sample passes with their field changes, passes already at the new values, passes it cannot change by reason, and how many holders would be told. Samples show each pass's own values, so a key needs passes:read. Counts and samples come from the 200 newest passes of the target and who is told is an estimate (`estimated`). It is the dry run of a change: it takes the same `target` and `patch` as `POST /broadcasts` and changes nothing. An input the template lacks gives empty `changes`; the run refuses it. Over 20,000 passes is 422 `MATCH_TOO_BROAD`.

post.summary: Set up scanning in one call (Idempotency-Key supported)
post.description: Makes the zones, events, staff, sessions and devices for a set of doors in one batch. Send an `Idempotency-Key`: the same key and body replays the answer with `replayed: true` and no PINs or pairing codes (codes that ran out are reissued, `pairingReissued: true`); the same key with another body is 409 `SCAN_SETUP_KEY_REUSED`. PINs and pairing codes appear once. `?dryRun=true` returns the plan and its checks with refs in place of ids and writes nothing. Any `error` check is 422 `SCAN_SETUP_CHECKS_FAILED`. `dryRun` needs no key and runs the same rules. A `scanning:write` key makes places (live) and devices with no pairing code; staff and pairing codes need `scanning:admin`.
